name: ro.listafirme/listafirme
title: ListaFirme
description: Romanian company search by CUI or name, financial statements, saved selections and work lists.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Free public search for Romanian companies by name, fiscal code (CUI), or Trade Register registration number. Returns up to 50 matches with links to listafirme.ro, the locality when available, and whether each company has been deregistered.

query.description: One company name, Romanian fiscal code (CUI), or Trade Register registration number. For example, 14837428 identifies BORG DESIGN SRL.

tools.name: search_listafirme_knowledge
tools.description: Search official ListaFirme documentation. Returns relevant topics and page guides with excerpts and source metadata.

query.description: Question or phrase about ListaFirme.ro, its pages, access rules, data, reports, API, or features.

limit.description: Maximum number of documentation matches, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: get_listafirme_topic
tools.description: Return one official ListaFirme documentation chapter by the topic ID returned from knowledge search.

tools.name: get_listafirme_page_guide
tools.description: Return the official guide for a known ListaFirme page. Accepts an ASP path, relative path, or full ListaFirme URL.

page.description: Known page path or ListaFirme URL, for example search.asp or https://listafirme.ro/search.asp.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Authenticated, free account status. Reports account association and API availability flags. Does not return API keys, personal identifiers, company data or credit balances. API tools require the separate listafirme.api permission and may be disabled by local configuration.

tools.name: search_companies_extended
tools.description: You can find Romanian companies by name, phone number, email, website or advanced criteria available on your ListaFirme API plan. A search normally costs 0.02 credits from your ListaFirme account. Searching by a valid Romanian tax code (CUI) alone is free. You receive up to 50 matches, the cost and your remaining balance. If more companies match, a narrower search can help you find the one you need.

query.description: Company name, CUI, phone number, email address, website or a search expression supported by your plan. A valid CUI alone (for example 14837428) costs zero credits; a search such as borgdesign.ro normally costs 0.02.

operation_id.description: A UUID identifies one operation. Reusing it for the same request protects against duplicate charges. A different UUID starts a separate operation that may incur another charge, even if the first charge is unconfirmed.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: You can look up a Romanian company by tax code (CUI) and choose which details you want, such as its name, status or website. The cost depends on the fields returned. BORG DESIGN (CUI 14837428) is free for all available fields, including financial statements. The result shows the cost and your remaining balance. By default, financial statements cover the latest year available and work locations include only active sites. Historical data is also available when requested.

tax_code.description: Romanian CUI, digits or RO prefix; checksum is validated.

fields.description: Company details to retrieve. Each name appears at most once. NACE returns the activity code; PrincipalNACE returns the recorded principal code(s) with their revision when available. The cost depends on the fields returned.

balance.description: Only with Balance: latest (default), all, or a four-digit year from 1900 to 2100.

nace_details.description: Only with NACE: true includes activity descriptions; false (default) returns the code with its revision when available.

operation_id.description: A UUID identifies one operation. Reusing it for the same request protects against duplicate charges. A different UUID starts a separate operation that may incur another charge, even if the first charge is unconfirmed.

tools.name: create_company_selection
tools.description: Saves company selection criteria in your ListaFirme account and returns the selection ID and link, with the applied criteria, filters, limit and any explicitly selected sort. A rejected criterion identifies the field, value and reason. Saving uses no API credits. Repeating the same request with the same operation ID within 24 hours returns the original selection. At or after expiry, it creates a new selection.

operation_id.description: Nonzero UUID for this save request. Within 24 hours of completion, the same UUID and arguments return the same selection. After expiry, the request creates a new selection.

name.description: Optional label for the saved selection in your ListaFirme account. Omitting it leaves the name blank.

baza_selectii.description: Starting population: active companies, all companies, or your account's work list. Defaults to active companies. A status selection other than operating alone switches the implicit base to all companies; an explicitly conflicting active base is rejected.

an_bilant.description: Financial reporting year for the selection, from 2008 through the latest year available in the API. Defaults to ListaFirme's standard reporting year. A newer partial year can be selected explicitly when available.

judete.description: Counties containing the registered office. A company can match any listed county. Values use the exact Romanian labels, for example ["CLUJ", "BIHOR"].

tip_localitate.description: Type of the locality, such as a village (Sat) or Bucharest sector (Sector). Applies to the locality rather than its parent administrative unit.

localitate.description: Locality name, for example Cluj-Napoca. With tip_uat and no uat, the API treats this name as the parent administrative unit.

tip_uat.description: Type of the parent administrative unit (UAT), such as a municipality (Municipiu) or commune (Comuna).

uat.description: Name of the parent administrative unit (UAT). A unit can include several localities.

judet.description: County name for this location, for example CLUJ. If judete is also supplied, the location must fall within that list.

localitati.description: Registered-office locations. Each entry selects a locality or administrative unit within the chosen counties. A county or parent unit can disambiguate places with the same name. For Dorohoi town alone, the first example selects the settlement. For the entire municipality, the second includes its component localities.

coduri.description: One or more CAEN codes or prefixes (2 to 4 digits) separated by commas, for example 0111, 62. Leading zeros are significant.

revizie.description: CAEN revision used to interpret coduri: 2 or 3. Only revision 3 is accepted for reporting years from 2026 onwards.

echivalare_revizii.description: Before reporting year 2026, true (default) includes equivalent codes from the other revision; false matches only the chosen revision. From 2026 this field must be omitted.

caen.description: Romanian activity classification (CAEN). Matches companies by their activity code for the selected financial year.

nume_tari.description: Country names from the ListaFirme nationality catalogue, for example Germania. The threshold applies separately to each selected country.

procentaj_minim_participare.description: Minimum ownership share for a selected nationality, from 0 to 100 percent inclusive. Defaults to 0.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

nationalitate_capital.description: Capital ownership by shareholder nationality and percentage held.

optiuni_sex.description: Shareholder sex categories. Matches any selected category whose ownership share meets the threshold.

procentaj_minim_participare.description: Minimum ownership share for a selected sex category, from 0 to 100 percent inclusive. Defaults to 0.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

sex_asociati.description: Capital ownership by the sex of individual shareholders.

forme_juridice.description: One or more legal forms. Each value is the full Romanian label in the list, including its abbreviation.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

forma_juridica.description: Registered legal form of the company.

tipuri_date_completate.description: Data categories to check. Telefon Fix sau Mobil matches either phone type. Note personale refers to notes in your own account.

mode.description: include (default) requires all selected categories to be present; exclude requires all selected categories to be absent.

date_completate.description: Availability of contact details, activity data or notes. Each selected category is checked separately.

tipuri_de_localitati.description: One or more locality categories, including urban or rural areas. A company can match any selected category.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

tipul_localitatii.description: Type of place containing the registered office.

tip_de_comert.description: Exportator matches exporters and Importator matches importers. Selecting both matches either activity.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

numar_minim_sedii.description: Inclusive minimum number of secondary locations, expressed as a count of sites.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

numar_sedii_secundare.description: Number of secondary business locations recorded for the company.

numar_minim_asociati.description: Inclusive minimum number of shareholders who are natural persons.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

numar_asociati.description: Number of individual shareholders recorded for the company.

operatori.description: One or more carrier identifiers, for example orange or vodafone. A recorded number with any selected carrier can match.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

operator_telefonie.description: Carrier of a recorded company phone number.

categorii_marime.description: One or more size classes, from micro to very large. Matches any selected class.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

categorie_marime.description: Company size class for the reporting year, based on employee count and, where applicable, turnover or total assets.

scheme_finantare.description: One or more programme names, for example Electric Up. Matches a funding record for any selected programme.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

scheme_finantare.description: Companies with a funding record under a selected programme.

stari_functiune.description: One or more status labels, for example functiune (operating), insolventa (insolvency), or radiata (deregistered).

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

stare_functiune.description: Registered company status. To select a non-operating status, the starting population must allow it.

data_minima_valabilitate.description: Earliest registered-office expiry date, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

data_maxima_valabilitate.description: Latest registered-office expiry date, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

valabilitate_sediu.description: Expiry date of the registered office, with one or both inclusive bounds. A missing expiry is compared as 2999-12-30.

procent.description: Nonzero percentage threshold. For example, 10 matches a current value at least 1.10 times the prior value; -10 matches a current value strictly below 0.90 times the prior value.

indicator.description: Financial statement measure to compare across the two years, for example Cifra afaceri (turnover) or Profit (net profit).

mode.description: include (default) keeps matches for this filter; exclude removes them.

evolutie_indicator_bilant.description: Change in a financial statement indicator compared with the preceding reporting year.

numar_minim_angajati.description: Minimum reported employee count, inclusive, in persons.

numar_maxim_angajati.description: Maximum reported employee count, inclusive, in persons.

numar_angajati.description: Employee count in the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

data_minima_infiintare.description: Earliest company incorporation date, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

data_maxima_infiintare.description: Latest company incorporation date, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

data_infiintare_firma.description: Date of incorporation. At least one inclusive bound is required.

cifra_minima_afaceri.description: Minimum turnover, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

cifra_maxima_afaceri.description: Maximum turnover, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

cifra_afaceri.description: Filters turnover for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

profitul_net_minim.description: Minimum net profit, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

profitul_net_maxim.description: Maximum net profit, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

profitul_net.description: Filters net profit for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

active_totale_minim.description: Minimum total assets, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

active_totale_maxim.description: Maximum total assets, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

active_totale.description: Filters total assets for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

datorii_totale_minim.description: Minimum total liabilities, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

datorii_totale_maxim.description: Maximum total liabilities, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

datorii_totale.description: Filters total liabilities for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

cheltuieli_totale_minim.description: Minimum total expenses, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

cheltuieli_totale_maxim.description: Maximum total expenses, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

cheltuieli_totale.description: Filters total expenses for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

venituri_totale_minim.description: Minimum total revenue, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

venituri_totale_maxim.description: Maximum total revenue, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

venituri_totale.description: Filters total revenue for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

capital_propriu_minim.description: Minimum shareholders' equity, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

capital_propriu_maxim.description: Maximum shareholders' equity, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

capital_propriu.description: Filters shareholders' equity for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

capital_social_minim.description: Minimum share capital, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

capital_social_maxim.description: Maximum share capital, inclusive, in whole units of moneda_filtrare (default RON).

capital_social.description: Filters share capital for the selected reporting year. At least one inclusive bound is required.

moneda_filtrare.description: Currency of all monetary bounds: RON (default), EUR or USD. For example, 1000000 means one million units. Conversion uses the rate for the selected reporting year.

asociat_juridic.description: Whether the company has a current shareholder that is a legal entity. True includes matches, false excludes them, and null or omission skips this filter.

capital_stat.description: Whether the company has state participation in its capital. True includes matches, false excludes them, and null or omission skips this filter.

capital_strain.description: Whether the company has foreign participation in its capital. True includes matches, false excludes them, and null or omission skips this filter.

obligata_audit.description: Whether the company is listed as subject to statutory audit. True includes matches, false excludes them, and null or omission skips this filter.

platitor_tva.description: VAT-register status: true selects records marked as VAT payers; false selects records with a non-payer flag. An absent VAT record matches neither value. Null or omission skips this filter.

vazute_recent.description: Whether the company was viewed by your account within the past six months, excluding your own company. True includes matches, false excludes them, and null or omission skips this filter.

listate_bpi.description: Whether the company has a listing in the Insolvency Proceedings Bulletin (BPI). True includes matches, false excludes them, and null or omission skips this filter.

filtre.description: Additional conditions combined with AND. Omit this object if there are no filters. The seven nullable company attributes can be combined only when all specified boolean values have the same polarity (true or false).

criteria.description: Company population, financial year, geographic area, activities and filters. An empty object uses the default population and financial year.

field.description: company_size ranks the largest companies by the ListaFirme size score, which combines turnover, total assets and employee count. turnover ranks companies by revenue alone. With direction desc, the largest score or highest revenue comes first. The optional second sort field breaks ties. random uses the stored random ordering.

direction.description: Sort direction for this field: asc orders from lowest to highest, desc from highest to lowest.

sort.description: Up to two distinct sort fields, in priority order. With no explicit sort, results follow ListaFirme rank in ascending order. The default sort is omitted from applied_selection.

top.description: Maximum number of matching companies across all pages. Omission leaves the selection uncapped. A saved limit of 1 to 5 makes the results a free sample; otherwise each valid page costs 0.02 credits.

tools.name: get_company_selection_results
tools.description: You can view a page of up to 50 companies in a selection saved to your ListaFirme account. A saved top of 1 to 5 inclusive is a free sample. Otherwise each valid page costs 0.02 credits, including page 1 when there are no matches. Page 1 gives the total and the last page. Requests beyond that limit are rejected before querying companies. Repeating the same request with the same operation ID within 24 hours of completion is free. At or after expiry it is a new request at the applicable price.

id_selectie.description: ID of a saved selection owned by your account, such as the id_selectie returned by create_company_selection.

page.description: Defaults to 1. Page 1 establishes the range. A later page requires a current range for this selection. PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE and PAGE_RANGE_REQUIRED do not query companies or incur a charge.

operation_id.description: A UUID identifies one page request for 24 hours after completion. Reusing the same UUID after expiry starts a new request at the applicable price.

tools.name: get_work_list_status
tools.description: Returns the number of companies in your ListaFirme work list and its current version. An empty list has a count of 0 and a null version. Free for connected accounts with the selections option.

tools.name: update_work_list
tools.description: All four work list operations (add, exclude, intersect, and clear) cost 0 ListaFirme credits. They update the same account list used by the ListaFirme website, API and ANIA. Requires a connected account with the selections option. A change applies only to the expected list version. Returns the counts added and removed, the resulting total and the list version.

inputSchema.description: One atomic change to the work list shared with the website and ANIA.

operation.description: add includes missing companies, exclude removes matches, intersect keeps only matches, and clear empties the list. Each operation costs 0 ListaFirme credits.

operation_id.description: Nonzero UUID identifying one change on this account. A confirmed ID is refused for 24 hours, even if the arguments change.

expected_version.description: List version reported by the latest status lookup or update. An explicit null represents an empty list. A mismatch prevents the change.

source.description: One set of companies, supplied as CUIs, an owned saved selection, or a predefined exclusion.

cuis.description: Romanian tax codes (CUIs). The API checks the control digit and whether each company exists. An invalid or unknown CUI prevents the entire change. Duplicate entries count toward the input limit and each company is applied once. The complete MCP message can be up to 1.5 MiB.

items.description: A positive Romanian CUI with 2 to 10 decimal digits. Text accepts an optional RO prefix (case-insensitive) and surrounding spaces. Numeric values use plain integer notation.

id_selectie.description: ID of an existing selection saved on this account. The entire selection is applied with its saved criteria, order and top.

predefined_list.description: Available with exclude. The five lists cover BPI notices from the last three years, ANAF debtors, ANAF inactive companies, court debtors from the last three years and connected companies.
